The issuer shows strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 41% (operating income of 1,307M on 3,198M revenue) and a solid asset base of 58.57B. However, the balance sheet exhibits significant leverage (total liabilities of 43.58B against equity of 12.81B), a weak current ratio of 0.53 (current assets of 3.24B vs current liabilities of 6.11B), and a large accumulated deficit (retained earnings of -12.24B). These liquidity constraints and high leverage offset the strong operating performance, pointing to a non-investment grade but currently viable credit profile.

DECISION: BB-
